October 2026 Master Rate Card Terms & Conditions

1. 10% cashback is eligible on the swiping amount.

2. SBI cashback is eligible for CC Brand EMI and CC fullswipe only on eligible models; exclusions apply to certain SBI card types and Rupay credit-card UPI transactions.

3. IDFC First, Yes, BOB, DBS, Kotak, Axis and IndusInd cashback eligibility applies only to eligible models and transaction types as specified in the October rate card.

4. OneCard cashback is eligible for CCEMI transactions only on eligible models.

5. HDFC cashback is eligible for CC/DC/Cardless Brand EMI (6 months and above), with the applicable LCE conditions stated in the October rate card.

6. Single card is eligible for one cashback from 1 Oct to 31 Dec 2026.

7. Different PoS partners may have different banks live on Brand EMI; check the Brand EMI status on PoS before transacting.

8. NCE means No Cost Brand EMI; LCE means Low Cost EMI; CIB means Customer Interest Bearing.

9. No offer is available with ICICI, RBL or AU cards.

10. UPI cashback is available only on the eligible series listed in the October rate card.

11. Please void/cancel the transaction if there is any issue related to cashback.

12. FREE 1 Year EW is available on V70 and V70 Elite series brand Full Swipe and UPI transactions.

13. V70/V70 Elite special offer: ₹3000 instant cashback is available on eligible UPI and Full-swipe transactions with selected credit cards, valid till 10 Oct 2026.

Partner Guide & Bajaj Scheme Rules

1. Official Bajaj Scheme Format (Tenure | Advance)

Bajaj Finance schemes follow the Tenure | Advance format (e.g., 24|0 = 24 Months tenure with 0 advance EMIs; 12|4 = 12 Months tenure with 4 advance EMIs). Each model variant lists its specific authorized Bajaj scheme matrix.

2. Fullswipe & UPI Cashback Qualification

Fullswipe and UPI cashback schemes apply when transactions are settled through authorized partner terminals (Pine Labs, Benow, Paytm, Innoviti, Razorpay).

3. HDFC LCE Special Rates

HDFC CC/DC/CL EMI Low Cost EMI (LCE) rates: 1.5% for Y Series, and 2.5% specifically for S2, X Series, and V Series models.
